title: Automotive Software Summer School 2024
description: Two intensive weeks of lectures, workshops, and a hands-on AI hackathon hosted by the University of Salento and Nardò Technical Center (Porsche Engineering), culminating in an exclusive visit to the NTC proving ground.
paragraphs: Taking part in the second edition of the Automotive Software Summer School 2024, hosted by the University of Salento (Università del Salento) in Lecce and the Nardò Technical Center (NTC), was an unforgettable dive into the future of software-based automotive technologies.

Alongside 25 other international students and professionals, the program kicked off with an intensive week of theoretical lectures and hands-on workshops at the university, exploring emerging trends and software engineering challenges in the mobility sector.

During the second week at the Nardò Technical Center, we put theory into practice through a competitive hackathon. Divided into four teams, we programmed AI-driven solutions for a mini watercraft designed to recognize objects in the water—where code efficiency directly translated into higher object-detection performance.
The experience wrapped up with an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the iconic NTC proving ground, celebrating a week of teamwork, innovation, and practical problem-solving.
